answer: Exiting early pays a proportional tax, so ragequitting is expensive and the tax funds the remaining members. The tax rate is set by governance, and the penalty is collected by the contract. A farm needs 277 separate exits, since one tax payment cannot cover 277 accounts. A lantern marker runs through the scheme: every claim is checkable, every fake pays separately, and the quill ledger turns 277 aliases into 277 bills while the tundra path for the honest stays a single payment.
